title: Set up AI in the right order
blurb: A five-step plan to get your first AI agent live without surprises.

steps.title: Open AI Agents
steps.body: Click **AI Agents** in the left menu.

steps.title: 1. Build the knowledge base
steps.body: Add your website, FAQs, prices and policies in **Knowledge Base**. The AI can only be as good as what you teach it.

steps.title: 2. Create one agent
steps.body: Start with one: a website chat bot or a phone receptionist.

steps.title: 3. Start in Suggestive
steps.body: Let it draft replies for you to approve for a week before switching to **Auto-Pilot**.

steps.title: 4. Review the logs
steps.body: Check **Agent Logs** and fill any gaps in the knowledge base.
steps.tip: AI use is billed on usage. Ask us about your plan: hello@luubu.com
